style_block: Soft pastel flat-vector illustration for a girls’ health app, rounded friendly shapes, subtle paper grain, gentle soft shadows, Indian girls aged 10 to 13 with warm brown skin tones and varied hair, modest everyday clothing, warm and calm mood. Palette: cream #FFFAF6 background, plum #3D2C4A for lines, rose #C2456A, sky #D8ECF8, mint #D4EFE4, peach #FFE3CC, lavender #E3DAF5, butter #FFF4C7. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
gigi_block: Gigi the mascot: a friendly 12-year-old Indian girl, warm brown skin, dark hair in two round buns, big kind eyes, soft blush pink kurta top.
